reform_act.caption: Britain abolished rotten boroughs and gave industrialists the vote. Workers turned to the Chartist movement.

zollverein.title: German Customs Union
zollverein.caption: Tariffs were removed among German states led by Prussia. Economic unity came before political unity.

morse.title: Morse's Telegraph
morse.caption: An American painter linked Washington and Baltimore by telegraph. The first message was "What hath God wrought."

irish_famine.title: Irish Potato Famine
irish_famine.caption: Blight wiped out the potato, Ireland's staple food. A million people died and many emigrated to America.

feb_revolution.title: French February Revolution
feb_revolution.caption: Parisians demanding wider voting rights overthrew Louis-Philippe, and revolution spread across Europe.

taiping.title: Taiping Rebellion
taiping.caption: A revolt led by Hong Xiuquan, inspired by Christianity. Making Nanjing its capital, it badly shook the Qing.

arrow_war.title: Second Opium War Begins
arrow_war.caption: Using the search of a British ship as a pretext, Britain and France attacked Qing. The Summer Palace burned, and Qing lost many rights.

italy_kingdom.title: Kingdom of Italy Proclaimed
italy_kingdom.caption: Through Cavour and Garibaldi, Italy was united under the king of Sardinia.

red_cross.title: Red Cross Founded
red_cross.caption: Founded at the call of Henri Dunant of Geneva after he saw the battlefield of Solferino.

london_underground.title: London Underground Opens
london_underground.caption: The world's first underground railway opened, with steam locomotives in its tunnels.

das_kapital.title: Marx's Capital, Volume One
das_kapital.caption: Marx analyzed how capitalism works. Engels later assembled the following volumes from his notes.

mendeleev.title: Mendeleev's Periodic Table
mendeleev.caption: The Russian chemist ordered the elements by atomic weight and even predicted elements not yet found.

paris_commune.title: Paris Commune
paris_commune.caption: After defeat by Prussia, the people of Paris set up their own government. It was crushed after 72 days.

berlin_congress.title: Congress of Berlin
berlin_congress.caption: Bismarck, the "honest broker," settled the aftermath of the Russo-Turkish War, checking Russia's push south.

koch_tb.title: Koch Finds the Tuberculosis Germ
koch_tb.caption: The German doctor found the cause of tuberculosis. He later won the Nobel Prize, and Kitasato was his student.

krakatoa.title: Eruption of Krakatoa
krakatoa.caption: An Indonesian volcano exploded, and tsunamis killed over 30,000 people. The blast was heard thousands of kilometers away.

berlin_conference.title: Berlin Conference on Africa
berlin_conference.caption: European powers set rules for dividing Africa. The Congo became the private property of the Belgian king.

benz.title: Benz Patents the Automobile
benz.caption: The German engineer patented a three-wheeled gasoline car, considered the first practical automobile.

dreyfus.title: Dreyfus Affair
dreyfus.caption: A Jewish officer was falsely convicted of spying and exiled. Zola's "J'accuse" split public opinion.

lumiere.title: Lumiere Brothers Show a Film
lumiere.caption: They held a paid film screening in a Paris cafe, seen as the birth of cinema.

curie_radium.title: The Curies Discover Radium
curie_radium.caption: The couple discovered polonium and the radioactive element radium. Marie won two Nobel Prizes.

hague_peace.title: First Hague Peace Conference
hague_peace.caption: An international meeting called by Russia. Arms cuts failed, but a treaty on peaceful settlement of disputes was signed.

boer_war.title: Boer War Begins
boer_war.caption: Britain, eager for the gold of the Transvaal, fought the Boers. The war went badly, shaking British prestige.

victoria_death.title: Death of Queen Victoria
victoria_death.caption: After reigning over 63 years, the queen died on the Isle of Wight, the end of an era.

marconi.title: Marconi's Transatlantic Radio
marconi.caption: The Italian inventor sent a radio signal across the Atlantic. He later won the Nobel Prize in Physics.

bloody_sunday.title: Bloody Sunday in Russia
bloody_sunday.caption: Troops fired on a crowd bringing a petition in St. Petersburg, setting off the Russian Revolution of 1905.

triple_entente.title: Anglo-Russian Entente
triple_entente.caption: Britain and Russia divided spheres in Asia. Britain, France and Russia lined up against Germany.

sarajevo.title: Assassination at Sarajevo
sarajevo.caption: The Austrian heir and his wife were shot by a young Serb, setting off World War I.

lusitania.title: Sinking of the Lusitania
lusitania.caption: A German submarine sank the British liner. Many Americans died, turning US opinion against Germany.

verdun.title: Battle of Verdun
verdun.caption: Germany and France fought for some ten months over the fortress, with 700,000 casualties. It is linked with Petain.

somme.title: Battle of the Somme
somme.caption: In the great Anglo-French offensive, Britain suffered about 60,000 casualties on the first day alone. Tanks were used in battle for the first time.

us_ww1.title: US Enters World War I
us_ww1.caption: After Germany's unrestricted submarine warfare and the Zimmermann Telegram, the United States joined the war.

spanish_flu.title: Spanish Flu Pandemic
spanish_flu.caption: An influenza that swept the world at the end of World War I. Deaths are thought to have reached tens of millions.

march_first.title: March First Movement
march_first.caption: A declaration of independence was read in Seoul, and protests spread across Korea. Japan put them down by force.

may_fourth.title: May Fourth Movement
may_fourth.caption: Begun by Beijing students angry at the Paris Peace Conference, it spread nationwide and launched Chinese nationalism.

weimar.title: Weimar Constitution
weimar.caption: Adopted in Germany after defeat, it set out universal suffrage for men and women and social rights. It was called the most democratic of its time.

washington_conf.title: Washington Naval Conference Opens
washington_conf.caption: Hosted by the US to discuss naval arms limits and China. The Anglo-Japanese Alliance was ended there.

ussr_founding.title: Soviet Union Founded
ussr_founding.caption: Russia and three other republics formed a union, the world's first socialist federal state.

march_on_rome.title: Mussolini's March on Rome
march_on_rome.caption: Mussolini of the Fascist Party marched on Rome and was appointed prime minister by the king.

turkey_republic.title: Republic of Turkey Founded
turkey_republic.caption: Mustafa Kemal abolished the sultanate, founded a republic and became its first president.

kellogg_briand.title: Kellogg-Briand Pact
kellogg_briand.caption: A treaty signed in Paris renouncing war, led by Kellogg and Briand.

salt_march.title: Gandhi's Salt March
salt_march.caption: Gandhi walked to the sea to protest the British salt monopoly, a symbol of nonviolent resistance.

empire_state.title: Empire State Building Completed
empire_state.caption: A 102-story skyscraper in New York, also famous from the film King Kong.

hitler_chancellor.title: Hitler Becomes Chancellor
hitler_chancellor.caption: President Hindenburg appointed Hitler chancellor. That year the Enabling Act secured his dictatorship.

new_deal.title: New Deal Begins
new_deal.caption: Franklin Roosevelt's response to the Great Depression, known for public works like the TVA.

long_march.title: Long March Begins
long_march.caption: Chased by the Nationalists, the Communist army walked over 10,000 km to Shaanxi. Mao Zedong's leadership was secured.

spanish_civil.title: Spanish Civil War Begins
spanish_civil.caption: Franco's rebels fought the Republican government. Germany and Italy intervened, and Hemingway took part.

guernica.title: Bombing of Guernica
guernica.caption: The German air force bombed a Basque town. Picasso's great painting Guernica shows the horror.

munich.title: Munich Agreement
munich.caption: Britain and France let Hitler take the Sudetenland, a symbol of the failure of appeasement.

molotov_ribbentrop.title: Nazi-Soviet Pact
molotov_ribbentrop.caption: Sworn enemies Germany and the USSR joined hands, shocking the world. A secret protocol divided Poland.

dunkirk.title: Dunkirk Evacuation
dunkirk.caption: About 340,000 British and French troops trapped by Germany escaped across the sea, some on small civilian boats.

barbarossa.title: Germany Invades the Soviet Union
barbarossa.caption: Germany launched a surprise attack on the USSR, the largest land war in history, with tens of millions dead.

atlantic_charter.title: Atlantic Charter
atlantic_charter.caption: Roosevelt and Churchill set out their postwar vision aboard a ship in the Atlantic. It led to the United Nations.

stalingrad.title: End of the Battle of Stalingrad
stalingrad.caption: Soviet forces surrounded the German Sixth Army and forced its surrender, the turning point of the war in the East.

bretton_woods.title: Bretton Woods Conference
bretton_woods.caption: It set up the postwar monetary system, creating the IMF and World Bank and making the dollar the key currency.

potsdam.title: Potsdam Conference
potsdam.caption: Truman, Churchill and Stalin discussed postwar Germany. A declaration demanding Japan's surrender was also issued.

truman_doctrine.title: Truman Doctrine
truman_doctrine.caption: The US pledged aid to Greece and Turkey and set out to contain communism, the start of the Cold War.

marshall_plan.title: Marshall Plan Announced
marshall_plan.caption: The US Secretary of State's plan for European recovery, which put Western Europe's economy back on its feet.

israel.title: State of Israel Founded
israel.caption: As the British mandate ended, Ben-Gurion declared the state. The first Arab-Israeli war began the next day.

berlin_blockade.title: Berlin Blockade
berlin_blockade.caption: The USSR cut land routes to West Berlin, and the US and Britain kept supplying it by air.

gandhi_death.title: Assassination of Gandhi
gandhi_death.caption: The father of Indian independence was shot dead by a young Hindu nationalist.

everest.title: First Ascent of Everest
everest.caption: Hillary and Tenzing first reached the top of the world's highest peak. The news came at Elizabeth II's coronation.

korean_armistice.title: Korean War Armistice
korean_armistice.caption: Signed at Panmunjom. No peace treaty has ever followed, and a military line still divides North and South.

dien_bien_phu.title: Battle of Dien Bien Phu
dien_bien_phu.caption: Vietnamese forces took the French base. The Indochina War ended with the Geneva Accords.

warsaw_pact.title: Warsaw Pact Formed
warsaw_pact.caption: A military alliance of the USSR and Eastern Europe, formed in answer to West Germany joining NATO.

suez_crisis.title: Suez Crisis
suez_crisis.caption: Egypt's Nasser nationalized the Suez Canal, and Britain, France and Israel attacked. US and Soviet pressure made them withdraw.

hungary_1956.title: Hungarian Revolution
hungary_1956.caption: Soviet troops crushed an uprising in Budapest for democracy. Its leader, Nagy, was executed.

eec.title: Treaty of Rome Signed
eec.caption: Six Western European nations created the European Economic Community, the forerunner of the EU.

africa_year.title: Year of Africa
africa_year.caption: Seventeen African nations won independence in a single year, boosting Africa's voice at the UN.

jfk_assassination.title: Assassination of Kennedy
jfk_assassination.caption: President Kennedy was shot during a parade in Dallas. Oswald was arrested but was himself shot soon after.

civil_rights_act.title: US Civil Rights Act
civil_rights_act.caption: Signed by President Johnson, it outlawed racial discrimination, the fruit of the movement led by Dr. King and others.

cultural_revolution.title: Cultural Revolution Begins
cultural_revolution.caption: Seeking to regain power, Mao Zedong unleashed the Red Guards. Society was thrown into chaos for ten years.

asean.title: ASEAN Founded
asean.caption: Five nations formed it with the Bangkok Declaration. It later grew to ten and promoted regional cooperation.

six_day.title: Six-Day War
six_day.caption: In six days Israel took the Sinai and the West Bank, deepening the Palestinian question.

king_assassination.title: Assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.
king_assassination.caption: The civil rights leader was shot in Memphis, and riots broke out across the country.

nixon_shock.title: Nixon Shock
nixon_shock.caption: President Nixon ended the exchange of dollars for gold. The Bretton Woods system ended, leading to floating exchange rates.

nixon_china.title: Nixon Visits China
nixon_china.caption: After Kissinger's groundwork, a US president visited China for the first time and met Mao Zedong.

watergate.title: Nixon Resigns
watergate.caption: The cover-up of a break-in at Democratic headquarters came out, and Nixon became the only US president to resign.

summit.title: First G6 Summit
summit.caption: After the oil crisis, leaders of six nations met at Rambouillet, France, the origin of today's G7.

deng_reform.title: Reform and Opening Up
deng_reform.caption: Deng Xiaoping began bringing market economics into China, which became the world's second-largest economy.

afghan_1979.title: Soviet Invasion of Afghanistan
afghan_1979.caption: Soviet troops invaded to prop up a friendly regime. The West boycotted the Moscow Olympics, and the USSR was bogged down.

iran_iraq.title: Iran-Iraq War Begins
iran_iraq.caption: Saddam Hussein's Iraq invaded Iran. The war lasted eight years and may have claimed nearly a million lives.

solidarnosc.title: Solidarity Founded
solidarnosc.caption: A union formed by Walesa and others at the Gdansk shipyard in Poland. It later led Eastern Europe toward democracy.

falklands.title: Falklands War
falklands.caption: Argentina seized British islands in the South Atlantic. Prime Minister Thatcher sent forces and retook them.

perestroika.title: Gorbachev Takes Power
perestroika.caption: Gorbachev became Soviet leader and pushed reform and openness, guiding the Cold War to its end.

inf_treaty.title: INF Treaty
inf_treaty.caption: Signed by Reagan and Gorbachev, the first agreement to eliminate an entire class of nuclear weapons.

tiananmen.title: Tiananmen Square Crackdown
tiananmen.caption: The army crushed students and others demanding democracy. Many are believed to have died.

malta.title: Malta Summit
malta.caption: Bush and Gorbachev declared the end of the Cold War on the Mediterranean island of Malta.

gulf_war.title: Gulf War
gulf_war.caption: After Iraq invaded Kuwait, a US-led coalition attacked. High-tech weapons were seen on TV.

www.title: World Wide Web Opens to the Public
www.caption: Tim Berners-Lee's information system was released, and the world's information began to connect.

apartheid_end.title: Mandela Becomes President
apartheid_end.caption: After apartheid ended, Mandela, jailed for 27 years, was elected president of South Africa.

wto.title: World Trade Organization Founded
wto.caption: A body built on GATT, based in Geneva, with a system to settle trade disputes.

dolly.title: Dolly the Sheep Born
dolly.caption: The world's first mammal cloned from an adult cell, born in Scotland. It sparked debate on bioethics.

euro.title: Euro Introduced
euro.caption: Eleven EU nations adopted a single currency for transactions. Notes and coins came into use in 2002.

macau.title: Return of Macau
macau.caption: Portugal handed Macau back to China, ending one of the last European colonies in Asia after some 440 years.

sept11.title: September 11 Attacks
sept11.caption: Hijacked airliners crashed into the World Trade Center and the Pentagon. About 3,000 people died.

iraq_war.title: Iraq War
iraq_war.caption: The US and Britain invaded, citing weapons of mass destruction, and toppled Saddam Hussein. No such weapons were found.

human_genome.title: Human Genome Decoded
human_genome.caption: International teams read the entire human genetic code, a big boost to medicine.

sumatra_tsunami.title: Indian Ocean Earthquake and Tsunami
sumatra_tsunami.caption: A huge quake on December 26 sent a tsunami across the Indian Ocean. Over 220,000 people died in many countries.

obama.title: Obama Becomes President
obama.caption: The first African American president in US history took office. He later won the Nobel Peace Prize.

paris_agreement.title: Paris Agreement Adopted
paris_agreement.caption: Nearly every nation agreed to cut greenhouse gases, aiming to keep warming below 2 degrees.

brexit.title: Brexit
brexit.caption: After the 2016 referendum, Britain left the EU, the first member state ever to leave.

covid_who.title: COVID-19 Declared a Pandemic
covid_who.caption: WHO chief Tedros declared the new coronavirus a pandemic. Life changed around the world.

granicus.title: Battle of the Granicus
granicus.caption: Alexander the Great's first major victory on Persian soil.

caesar_gaul.title: Caesar Begins the Gallic Wars
caesar_gaul.caption: Caesar marched into what is now France. His own account, the Gallic War, is famous for its fine prose.

carrhae.title: Battle of Carrhae
carrhae.caption: Rome's Crassus was crushed and killed by Parthian horse archers, helping bring down the First Triumvirate.

nero_death.title: Death of Nero
nero_death.caption: Declared an enemy of the state by the Senate, the emperor killed himself, ending the Julio-Claudian dynasty.

constantine_death.title: Death of Constantine
constantine_death.caption: The emperor is said to have been baptized a Christian on his deathbed.

chalcedon.title: Council of Chalcedon
chalcedon.caption: It declared Christ both fully divine and fully human. The single-nature view was condemned as heresy.

justinian.title: Justinian I Becomes Emperor
justinian.caption: An emperor from a peasant family took the throne. Seeking to restore the Roman Empire, he again ringed the Mediterranean.

nika.title: Nika Riots
nika.caption: Riots at the hippodrome set the capital on fire. Urged on by Empress Theodora, the emperor stood firm and crushed them.

xuanzong.title: Emperor Xuanzong Takes the Throne
xuanzong.caption: Xuanzong of Tang came to the throne. His early reign was a golden age; in later years he loved Yang Guifei.

harun.title: Harun al-Rashid Becomes Caliph
harun.caption: The caliph of the Abbasid golden age took power. He also appears in the Thousand and One Nights.

mersen.title: Treaty of Meerssen
mersen.caption: After Verdun, the northern Middle Frankish kingdom was divided, the rough outline of today's German, French and Italian borders.

toledo.title: Christians Retake Toledo
toledo.caption: Alfonso VI of Castile took Toledo. From there, Arabic learning was translated for Western Europe.

ayyubid.title: Ayyubid Dynasty Founded
ayyubid.caption: Saladin founded a dynasty in Egypt and later abolished the Fatimid caliphate.

seventh_crusade.title: Seventh Crusade
seventh_crusade.caption: King Louis IX of France attacked Egypt but was defeated and captured. He was later called Saint Louis.

mamluk.title: Mamluk Sultanate Founded
mamluk.caption: Slave soldiers of the Ayyubids founded a dynasty in Egypt. They made their name by driving back the Mongols.

kosovo.title: Battle of Kosovo
kosovo.caption: The Ottoman army defeated the Serbs, a battle deeply etched in Serbian national memory.

nicopolis.title: Battle of Nicopolis
nicopolis.caption: Ottoman sultan Bayezid I defeated a crusade led by the king of Hungary.

timur_delhi.title: Timur Sacks Delhi
timur_delhi.caption: Timur, master of Central Asia, invaded India and looted Delhi. The Tughluq dynasty was badly weakened.

inquisition.title: Spanish Inquisition Set Up
inquisition.caption: Ferdinand II and Isabella I set it up with papal approval. Converts and others were harshly examined.

spain_union.title: Castile and Aragon United
spain_union.caption: The two kingdoms were joined under the royal couple Isabella and Ferdinand, the start of the Spanish kingdom.

petition_right.title: Petition of Right
petition_right.caption: Parliament made Charles I accept it, banning taxes without consent and unlawful arrest.

harvey.title: Harvey's Circulation of the Blood
harvey.caption: The English doctor showed by experiment that blood circulates from the heart through the body, overturning ancient beliefs.

galileo_trial.title: Trial of Galileo
galileo_trial.caption: The Roman Inquisition ordered him to give up the idea that the Earth moves. Legend says he muttered, "And yet it moves."

descartes.title: Descartes's Discourse on Method
descartes.caption: The French philosopher's book that set out "I think, therefore I am," the starting point of modern philosophy.

leviathan.title: Hobbes's Leviathan
leviathan.caption: An English work of political thought that saw the state of nature as "a war of all against all."

peter_embassy.title: Peter the Great's Grand Embassy
peter_embassy.caption: Traveling incognito through Western Europe, Peter worked as a shipwright in the Netherlands, the start of Russia's Westernization.

frederick2.title: Frederick the Great Takes the Throne
frederick2.caption: The enlightened despot called "the Great" came to the throne. He called the ruler "the first servant of the state."

boston_massacre.title: Boston Massacre
boston_massacre.caption: British soldiers fired on a crowd, killing five. It sharply raised anti-British feeling in the colonies.

lewis_clark.title: Lewis and Clark Expedition Sets Out
lewis_clark.caption: Sent by President Jefferson, they crossed the continent to the Pacific, helped by the Shoshone guide Sacagawea.

mexico_hidalgo.title: Hidalgo's Uprising
mexico_hidalgo.caption: The priest Hidalgo called the people to arms with the "Cry of Dolores," beginning Mexico's War of Independence.

brazil_independence.title: Brazilian Independence
brazil_independence.caption: Pedro, a Portuguese prince, declared Brazil independent and became its emperor.

faraday.title: Faraday Discovers Induction
faraday.caption: He found that moving a magnet creates an electric current, the basis of generators and transformers.

beagle.title: HMS Beagle Sets Sail
beagle.caption: The ship left Britain with young Darwin aboard. What he saw in the Galapagos shaped his theory of evolution.

mexican_war.title: Mexican-American War
mexican_war.caption: A war over the annexation of Texas. The victorious US gained California and other vast lands.

indian_empire.title: Indian Empire Proclaimed
indian_empire.caption: Queen Victoria became Empress of India, a policy of Prime Minister Disraeli.

phonograph.title: Edison Invents the Phonograph
phonograph.caption: Edison built a machine that recorded and played back sound. Its first recording is said to be "Mary Had a Little Lamb."

pasteur_rabies.title: Pasteur's Rabies Vaccine
pasteur_rabies.caption: The French scientist successfully gave a rabies vaccine to a boy, and later founded the Pasteur Institute.

easter_rising.title: Easter Rising
easter_rising.caption: Irish republicans rose up in Dublin. Executions after it was crushed turned opinion toward independence.

insulin.title: Discovery of Insulin
insulin.caption: Banting and Best of Canada opened the way to treating diabetes and later won the Nobel Prize.

baird_tv.title: Baird Demonstrates Television
baird_tv.caption: The Scottish inventor gave a public demonstration of mechanical television in London.

anschluss.title: Anschluss with Austria
anschluss.caption: Hitler sent German troops into Austria and annexed it, folding his homeland into his empire.

nuremberg.title: Nuremberg Trials Open
nuremberg.caption: The Allies tried the leaders of Nazi Germany, the first trial for "crimes against humanity."

hubble.title: Hubble Space Telescope Launched
hubble.caption: Carried up by the Space Shuttle, it sent back countless images of the cosmos, free of the blur of Earth's air.

channel_tunnel.title: Channel Tunnel Opens
channel_tunnel.caption: An undersea rail tunnel linking Britain and France. The Eurostar now runs through it, a dream since Napoleon's time.

iss.title: Building of the ISS Begins
iss.caption: Many nations led by the US and Russia began building it. Japan's Kibo lab was later attached.
